newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end softer, more consolidation seen.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end softer, more consolidation seen.

text.p: * Toronto stocks ended softer on Wednesday as Canadian equities moved into a consolidation phase * Weak golds, base metals offset by banks, technology * 99 million shares traded
Toronto stocks ended softer on Wednesday, surrendering earlier gains as the market headed into a consolidation phase, analysts said.
The TSE 300 Index slipped 4.10 points to close at 6428.62 in turnover of 99.17 million shares worth C$1.54 billion.
Advancing and declining stocks were even at 485 each, with 309 issues were unchanged.
"Stock markets have had a strong run up and there are no major earnings in the near term. I think the market is due for some consolidation," said CIBC Wood Gundy chief strategist Subodh Kumar.
